insights.summary: FY26 consolidated revenue rose 40% to ₹600 Cr and PAT 45% to ₹76 Cr, as the new Neemrana plant (6x the old one) began contributing; the old plant is full and the new one ran at only ~15% utilisation. Management expects the new plant at ~50% utilisation in FY27 and ~80% in FY28 (the presentation puts combined peak revenue at ₹2,250-2,850 Cr), exports to double from ~₹100 Cr, and Bus AC to take 15% market share. Inventory tripled to 242 days and operating cash flow was –₹114 Cr; the board approved a fund-raise of up to ₹500 Cr, mainly for working capital.

what_changed.text: New plant utilisation roadmap: ~50% in FY27, ~80% in FY28
Exports to roughly double to ~₹200 Cr in FY27
Entered Bus AC (Sphere acquisition); targeting 15% market share
Enabling resolution to raise up to ₹500 Cr (QIP), mainly for working capital
Approved for railways bar-and-plate heat exchangers; L1 in three tenders

analyst_questions.answer: UAE order stuck by the war (₹15-20 Cr), ₹8 Cr shipped but not billed, BIS stock-up on inner-groove tube, new product lines; should be under control within three quarters.

analyst_questions.topic: Why raise equity after an IPO?
analyst_questions.answer: IPO money and more went into the new plant; working capital is now short. Purpose 'not concluded'.
Plant fully commissioned only in March 2026; customer approvals for eight new products now done.
Copper, aluminium LME and USD/INR passed through quarterly, with a one-quarter lag.
~16% of FY26 revenue, 18.7% in Q4; Schneider Electric the largest DC customer; Vertiv approval done.

red_flags.text: Operating cash flow –₹114 Cr in FY26; inventory 242 days, debtor days 106.
Equity raise of up to ₹500 Cr soon after the IPO, with the purpose 'still not concluded'.
Only ~5% of revenue is from products other than fin-and-tube heat exchangers.
Several answers vague ('number I cannot disclose', data 'not prepared').

business_snapshot.what_they_make: Fin-and-tube heat exchangers (95% of revenue) for HVAC&R, plus new lines: bar-and-plate, refrigeration condensers and evaporators, dry coolers, ammonia evaporators and Bus AC systems
business_snapshot.customers: Commercial and residential HVAC OEMs (Daikin-type majors), data-centre cooling makers such as Schneider Electric and soon Vertiv, refrigeration OEMs, Indian Railways, export customers in UAE, US and Europe
business_snapshot.revenue_mix: FY26: domestic 83%, exports 17% (UAE 38%, USA 31% of exports); data centres ~16%
business_snapshot.demand_drivers: Data-centre and commercial HVAC build-out, import substitution, Bus AC and railway HVAC, export wins in North America and Europe
